**Repaired finding submitted: compliant (at fallback) — no redline.**

The only defect was the evidentiary quote: my original citation captured the indemnity verb but stopped before the infringement trigger, which caused the "vendor indemnity for IP infringement present" check to fail on its face. The repaired quote is a single contiguous span of p0090 that now carries both elements — the hold-harmless/Losses language (including settlement amounts and reasonable legal fees) **and** the express infringement trigger ("If the Work or any portion thereof is held to constitute an infringement") — so the check can be satisfied on the cited text itself.

Substance is unchanged and confirmed:
- **Vendor-side IP indemnity present:** Garman's ownership/no-encumbrance warranty is backed by an indemnity to Sparkling for all Losses on breach.
- **Usual remedy ladder:** procure rights, procure an equivalent element, or replace/modify (p0091–p0093) — the rule's fallback.
- **Direction correct:** indemnity runs to us; no reverse or one-way Sparkling indemnity exists, so walk-away does not apply.
- **Better than fallback on cap:** Section 15 excludes Section 13 breaches from both the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion, leaving the indemnity uncapped rather than at a 3× super-cap.

Preferred-position shortfalls (no express defend/control mechanic, no refund remedy, IP-only scope, affiliates unnamed, ten-day notice) remain recorded in the rationale as sub-elements for negotiation leverage, not as deviations. Confidence raised to 0.85.
